provenance.dataGenerationMethod: Scraped from public GitHub repositories using GitHub API. Filtered for Python code files with permissive licenses (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD). Deduplicated using MinHash LSH with Jaccard similarity threshold of 0.85.
provenance.dataFormat: JSON Lines (.jsonl), each record contains: code snippet (string), repository name, file path, license type, star count, last commit date
provenance.dataSubjectivity: Objective - source code is deterministic. However, code quality and style vary based on author preferences and project conventions
dataProcessingSteps: GitHub API scraping of public repositories
License detection and filtering (only MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD)
PII detection and filtering (email addresses, API keys)
Repository metadata extraction (stars, forks, last activity)

use.intendedUse: Training large language models for code generation and completion. Suitable for pre-training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of Python code models. Educational use for studying code patterns and software engineering practices.
use.restrictions: Subject to original open-source licenses (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD). Attribution required for derived models. Not suitable for training models that will generate closed-source commercial code without proper license compliance review.
use.legalRightsToUse: Collected from public repositories with permissive licenses. Complies with GitHub Terms of Service for API usage. Fair use doctrine applies for ML training purposes under current US copyright law interpretations.
use.privacyMeasures: Automated PII detection removed: email addresses (99.2% recall), API keys and tokens (100% recall using regex patterns), SSH keys, AWS credentials, database connection strings. Manual review of flagged files.
use.dataProcessingLocation: AWS us-west-2 (data collection and processing), HuggingFace Hub CDN (distribution)

_comments.why_this_matters: Code datasets raise unique IP concerns - must document license compliance for legal use in AI training. Recent litigation (GitHub Copilot lawsuits) makes provenance documentation critical.
_comments.key_challenges: License compliance verification at scale, PII detection in code comments, deduplication without losing important variations, handling code from deprecated Python versions
_comments.ai_act_relevance: EU AI Act requires training data documentation for high-risk AI systems. Code generation models may fall under general-purpose AI regulations requiring transparency about training data sources.
